  • Israel internal: Netanyahu spoke with Trump and agreed to meet. IDF strengthening Israeli Security Forces for possible renewed Gaza operations.

Northern Border

  • Hezbollah: daily activity and missile launches toward northern Israel continue.

Diplomacy & International

  • US intelligence warned Iran Israel might plan to target Iranian ceasefire negotiators — raised mistrust and likely affected pause dynamics.

Domestic Iran

  • Mass funeral events and rallies in Tehran around Khamenei; high public mobilization and anti-US chants.

🟢 Good News

  • Temporary pause on energy strikes + Pakistan mediation provide a diplomatic window.
  • Allied defensive support increased (German Arrow 3 expansion).
Threat assessment: Escalating — daily cross-border strikes and air operations keep risk of broader confrontation high.
